description: List leads (deals) in amoCRM with optional search and filtering. Supports pagination (max 250 per page), search by keyword, and sorting. Use the "with" parameter to include related contacts, companies, tags, loss_reason. Returns HAL+JSON with _embedded.leads array.

query.description: Search query string to filter leads by filled fields

limit.description: Number of results per page, max 250 (default: 50)

with.description: Comma-separated list of related entities to include: contacts, companies, tags, catalog_elements, loss_reason, source

order.description: Sort order by updated_at (asc or desc)
